title: Dynamics of exponential-trigonometric entire maps
exact_target: Describe the iteration dynamics of the exponential-times-sine and exponential-times-cosine families as their complex parameter varies.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300060 (AMR-052-0060). CC BY 4.0.

Robert Devaney, ``Open Questions in Non-Rational Complex Dynamics'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), second problem in Section 1, pp. 35; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
